app.name: File Finder
app.tagline: Offline search across your work files
search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Search file and folder names, paths, and the text inside PDF, Word and Excel files.
search.placeholder: Search by name, path or content…
search.hint: Put "quotes" around words to search them as one exact phrase. Arabic diacritics, hamza forms and Arabic-Indic digits are matched automatically.
search.sort.label: Sort by
search.sort.name: Name
search.empty.title: Nothing matches this search
search.empty.hint: Try fewer words, or check that the folder holding the file is indexed.
search.start.title: Search your files
search.start.hint: Type a word from a file name, a folder name, or the text inside a document, then press Enter.
search.match.name: Name
search.failed: The search could not be completed
result.reindex.done: Re-indexed {name}. The results are up to date.
result.ocr.done: OCR finished for {name}. The results are up to date.
open.error.missing: This file was deleted or moved outside the app, so it cannot be opened: {path}
open.error.not_directory: This folder no longer exists on disk: {path}
open.error.open_failed: Windows could not open the file: {detail}
open.error.not_indexed: This item is no longer in the index. Refresh the index and try again.
index.title: Indexing
index.subtitle: Files are only read. Nothing is copied, moved, changed or uploaded.
index.ocr.hint: Stop cancels OCR safely; everything already indexed is kept.
index.stats.title: What is in the index
index.empty.title: No folders yet
index.empty.hint: Add a folder and the index will be built from it.
folders.title: Indexed folders
folders.subtitle: Removing a folder only clears it from the index. The files on disk are never touched.
folders.empty.title: No folders added
folders.empty.hint: Pick one or more folders that hold your work files.
log.title: Index log
log.subtitle: Every file that could not be indexed is listed here with the reason.
log.empty.title: Nothing logged
log.empty.hint: Skipped and failed files will show up here.
sidebar.status.title: Index status
diagnostics.title: Application diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Everything below is stored on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
